name: JAMTRACK
author: PhilipsKnobs
tagline: a backing band for the FM-1
description: JAMTRACK turns the FM-1 into a backing band to play over: drums, bass, chords and a synth line follow a chord progression in any key and time signature, in time with a loop pedal. 160 factory jams in 16 genres, GENERATE by genre, your own synth line on a 16-step piano roll, parts A and B with fills and endings, tap tempo, MIDI clock, START and STOP, a user drum kit, and a companion web app that edits, saves and shares jams.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments), MPL-2.0.
